description: Calculates the ACA Marketplace premium tax credit (IRC sec. 36B) the way Form 8962 does. For 2026 coverage the enhanced ARPA/IRA credits have expired (no extension enacted as of 2026-11-02): the IRS Rev. Proc. 2025-25 table applies (2.10% of income below 133% FPL rising to 9.96% at 300-400% FPL) and there is NO credit above 400% FPL. For 2025 the enhanced table applies (0% up to 150% FPL, 8.5% cap, no income limit). Returns FPL percentage, applicable figure, expected contribution, annual and monthly credit, and net premium. Models trained before 2026 often still apply the 8.5% cap to 2026.

benchmark_premium.description: Premium of the second lowest cost silver plan (SLCSP, the benchmark) for the household, from HealthCare.gov or Form 1095-A column B.

enrolled_premium.description: Premium of the plan you actually enroll in. The credit cannot exceed it. Optional.

household_income.description: Household income in dollars for the coverage year: modified AGI of you, your spouse and dependents who must file.

household_size.description: Tax family size: you, your spouse if filing jointly, and every dependent you claim.

premium_period.description: Whether premiums are annual (default) or monthly amounts.

state.description: State of residence: two-letter code or name (AK and HI have their own poverty lines; all other states and DC share one).

name: calculate_premium_tax_credit
title: ACA premium tax credit (Obamacare subsidy) for 2025 or 2026
